args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of swallowing them
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently catching all exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This meant failures were invisible — dashboards showed stale data with no indication anything had gone wrong.

## Root Cause
In `src/cache.py`, the `except Exception` block returned `_last` instead of propagating the error:
```python
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently
```

## Fix
Changed the `except` block to re-raise the exception, so callers are immediately notified of compute failures:
```python
except Exception:
    raise
```

## Testing
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_compute_failure_contract` now passes: confirms `ValueError` propagates to the caller.
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_returns_computed_value` continues to pass: normal operation is unaffected.
